Relational databases organize data into related tables; NoSQL databases use alternative models such
as documents, key-value pairs, wide columns or graphs.
SQL වල rows සහ tables අතර relationships keys මඟින් සමේබන්ධ කරනවා. MongoDB වල related
fields එක document එකක් තුළ තියාගන්න පුළුවන්. Jතතෝරන්Jන් data access pattern, consistency සහ

A pharmacy can store product details in documents, while a relational system can join products and
stock tables.

SQL: products, stock JOIN on product_id combined rows · MongoDB: product document embedded stock one read · SQL: products, stock → JOIN on product_id → combined rows; MongoDB: product document → embedded stock → one read
Diagram එJක් arrows අනුව data Jහතෝ operation එක ගමන් කරන ආකාරය බලන්න. SQL වල rows සහ tables අතර relationships keys මඟින් සමේබන්ධ කරනවා.
Expected result: Both return product names and stock when their respective schemas contain those fields.

Interview question: Is NoSQL always faster than SQL?
Answer: No. Performance depends on schema, access patterns, indexes and workload. Both can
support transactions.

Remember: Model first, database second.
